description.value: Located in historic Fort Langley, the BC Farm Museum houses the province's largest collection of pioneer and agricultural artifacts, tracing the development of farming in British Columbia from the 1800s onward. The volunteer-run museum features exhibits on tractors, steam engines, dairy equipment, beekeeping, and even a vintage Oakalla Prison Farm wagon. Fort Langley itself is a charming village along popular Fraser Valley cycling routes, making the museum a worthwhile stop for touring cyclists exploring the area.
